pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 13.4.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE PLAY: STYLE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the role of humour in a play?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play
2. dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play
   In simple words: practise until you can dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style.
4. Show that you can: identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Search for examples of humour and monologue from print and non print sources and read them aloud or re- enact them in pairs,
2. In groups, identify and illustrate humour and monologue in the grade- appropriate play and display them in a graphic organiser,
3. Watch or read episodes of the grade- appropriate play containing humour and monologue,
4. Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner uses digital tools to record dramatised sections of the text.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of humour in a play?
2. Which programmes on radio or television do you find amusing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play
2. dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
